official_units: kW (kilowatts per 15-minute interval; divide by 4 for kWh)

dst_irregularities_documented.march_spring_forward: Values between 01:00 and 02:00 set to 0.0 for all clients (96 intervals maintained)
dst_irregularities_documented.october_fall_back: Values between 01:00 and 02:00 aggregate consumption of 2 hours (96 intervals maintained)
dst_irregularities_documented.uniform_day_length: Every calendar day has exactly 96 measures (24 * 4)

cohort_audit.zero_structure_finding: 212 clients exhibit solid leading zero blocks before first non-zero observation. Post-activation median zero rate is 0.01% (mean 1.19%). Leading zeros represent uncreated meters as confirmed by official UCI documentation.

evaluated_cohort_definitions.name: All 370 Clients (all_370)
evaluated_cohort_definitions.flaw: Non-stationary cohort membership. 49 clients onboarded during 2012-2014, causing artificial +5.70% aggregate demand growth due to meter addition.

evaluated_cohort_definitions.name: Fixed Cohort 320 Clients (cohort_320, RECOMMENDED)
evaluated_cohort_definitions.merits: 100% of the 320 clients are established on or before day 1 hour 1 of the study period. Zero onboarding expansion occurs during 2012-2014. Represents 99.76% of total 2012 load.

evaluated_cohort_definitions.name: Canonical Literature Cohort 321 (cohort_321)
evaluated_cohort_definitions.merits: Aligns with LSTNet (Lai et al. 2018) and DeepAR (Salinas et al. 2020) 321-client benchmark. Differs from Cohort 320 by exactly 1 client (MT_146, which activated 2012-01-07 16:30:00).

dst_audit_empirical_confirmation.march_spring_forward: Confirmed. Values between 01:00:00 and 01:45:00 drop to near-zero (e.g. 0.4 - 4.4 MW sum across all clients) because civil hour did not exist and was filled with zeros by data donor to maintain exactly 96 intervals per day.
dst_audit_empirical_confirmation.october_fall_back: Confirmed. Values between 01:00:00 and 01:45:00 double (e.g. 240-275 MW vs 120-135 MW) because repeated civil hour was aggregated together into the four 15-minute intervals.
dst_audit_empirical_confirmation.calendar_integrity: Every day has strictly 96 intervals. Total hourly count for 2012-2014 is exactly 26,304 hours (1,096 days * 24).

cohort_audit.hourly_timestamp_convention: Hour-Ending (e.g. 00:15, 00:30, 00:45, 01:00 are averaged to represent the hour ending at 01:00:00). First hourly timestamp: 2012-01-01 01:00:00. Last hourly timestamp: 2015-01-01 00:00:00.
